request.project_name: Phase 17 Education, GDP, and Life Expectancy

research_question.raw_text: How is educational attainment associated with life expectancy after accounting for GDP per capita?
research_question.population: Country-year observations with WDI, WHO, and UNESCO coverage
assumptions: Complete-case associational model; no causal identification claim.
exclusions: No interpolation, imputation, smoothing, sex averaging, or education index.
